note: Starting hyperparameters of the LightGBM ranking scorer. They are the best configuration of an earlier Bayesian search (Optuna TPE, 40 trials) run on the archived 28-feature table: archive/round1_28_features/results/optuna_best.json. The Bayesian search on the 46-feature table (scripts/bayes_opt_v2.py) started from them and did not find a better setting.
